status_note: Draft coding of 2 November 2026. Not graded yet. Since 0.9.0: seven orders the posts describe without quoting were read at the source (free PDFs in the RECAP archive) and coded from their own text; two anchors that pointed to the wrong post were corrected (Hintermaier, Brower: post 5724); four RECAP copies have no usable text layer and are being OCR'd before they are coded; four civil orders are still being checked for a free copy.
add_rules: R10. An order the posts describe without quoting is coded from its own text when a free copy is in the RECAP archive (the pre-registration counts an order as not codable only if it also cannot be read free at the source). Its spans point to src:<case_id>, the text pypdf 5.1.0 extracted from that PDF with only CM/ECF page-header stamps and bare page-number lines removed; extraction artefacts (split words, stray date stamps) are left as they are, and quotations skip them with '...'. Where pypdf returns a passage out of page order, the passage is given as two spans in reading order.

replace.order: Stipulated protective order approved 7 Jul 2026 (ECF 75), section 13.4; read at the source: RECAP archive

spans.start: 13.4 Large Language Models / Generative AI Tools.
into model weights, or otherwise train on Protected Material

tests.NOTICE: Without notifying and obtaining permission from the Producing Party
tests.DATA: do not incorporate inputs into model weights, or otherwise train on Protected Material
tests.OTHER: adhere to industry standard cybersecurity practices

replace.setup_a_quote: without taking commercially reasonable efforts to ensure such tools (a) do not incorporate inputs
replace.note: R10. Use without the producing party's permission is barred only where commercially reasonable efforts to ensure the two safeguards were not taken, so a tool meeting them needs no permission. Names Meta LLAMA, an openly published model, among example tools the safeguards apply to, without making openness a test; the parties' enterprise ChatGPT and Harvey accounts are deemed to satisfy the safeguards. pypdf returns the end of section 13.4 after section 14, so the passage is two spans in reading order.
